title: Diosmetin alleviates hyperuricemic nephropathy by activating the BNIP3/Nrf2/GPX4 pathway to inhibit ferroptosis of renal tubular epithelial cells induced by monosodium urate crystals.
authors: Hu, Chengming; Dong, Changle; Yang, Huimin; Yu, Zejun; Li, Yang; Qiu, Yinsheng; Mei, Zhinan; Xu, Lingyun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物香叶木素通过BNIP3/Nrf2/GPX4通路抑制肾小管上皮细胞铁死亡，虽涉及分子对接，但核心是细胞铁死亡与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Hyperuricemic nephropathy (HN) is a serious kidney complication of hyperuricemia, yet effective treatments are lacking. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death driven by lipid peroxidation, has been implicated in renal tubular injury, but its regulatory mechanisms in HN remain unclear. This study investigated the protective effects of diosmetin (DIOS), a natural flavonoid with antioxidant properties, against monosodium urate (MSU)-induced damage in HK-2 human renal tubular cells. We confirmed that MSU-induced cell death was characteristic of ferroptosis. Through a combination of transcriptomic analysis and network pharmacology, we identified the BNIP3/Nrf2/GPX4 pathway as the primary potential target of DIOS. Molecular docking and subsequent experimental validation demonstrated that DIOS directly interacts with and modulates BNIP3, leading to the activation of Nrf2 and the upregulation of its downstream target, GPX4. This cascade enhanced the cellular antioxidant defense system, effectively suppressing lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis. Our findings reveal a novel mechanism by which DIOS protects against MSU-induced renal tubular injury and highlight the BNIP3/Nrf2/GPX4 axis as a promising therapeutic target for mitigating ferroptosis in HN.
abstract_zh: 高尿酸血症肾病（HN）是高尿酸血症的一种严重肾脏并发症，但目前缺乏有效治疗方法。铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由脂质过氧化驱动的铁依赖性调节性细胞死亡形式，已被认为与肾小管损伤相关，但其在HN中的调控机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了具有抗氧化特性的天然黄酮类化合物香叶木素（diosmetin, DIOS）对单钠尿酸盐（monosodium urate, MSU）诱导的人肾小管上皮细胞HK-2损伤的保护作用。我们确认MSU诱导的细胞死亡具有铁死亡特征。通过转录组分析与网络药理学相结合，我们鉴定出BNIP3/Nrf2/GPX4通路为DIOS的主要潜在靶点。分子对接及后续实验验证表明，DIOS直接与BNIP3相互作用并调节其功能，导致Nrf2激活及其下游靶点GPX4上调。这一级联反应增强了细胞抗氧化防御系统，有效抑制了脂质过氧化和铁死亡。我们的发现揭示了DIOS保护MSU诱导的肾小管损伤的新机制，并强调BNIP3/Nrf2/GPX4轴作为减轻HN中铁死亡的潜在治疗靶点。
